$Comment: What the chest hidden in the Turkey Graveyard holds, rolled fresh into it each time a party's graveyard is pasted (tools/arenas/Harvest_Feast_Turkey_Graveyard.json names it on the chest): a pumpkin pie or two every time, then each Choice below on its own when its Weight, its chance out of 100, comes up: Spices for Martha's dishes, and one of her Turkey Pies. It holds no Wishbone on purpose: the chest refills every run, so a Wishbone here would make the way in pay for itself.
